svg.title: Asked if an event happened: 134 results on matched pairs of clips
svg.desc: Asked if an event happened: 134 results on matched pairs of clips. Each result is one model on one pair at one of four video encodings: a clip with the event and a matching clip without it. Said Yes to both clips: 99. Correct: Yes with the event, No without it: 23. Said No to both clips: 9. No with the event, Yes without it: 3.
